channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
channel.desc: Breaking news, today's star-studded shopping spree features award-winning journalist and newscaster Nina Hossain, along with fellow reporter Lucrezia Millarini. This pair of newsies are driving a custard-coloured 1955 Ford Pop Hot Rod, with expert advice provided by Dorset's Tim Medhurst and Geordie-boy Steven Moore, who are piloting a 1960s Ford Thames between the antique shops and emporia.
